title: Invitation to IP Manthan on “Patentability of Computer-Related Inventions (CRI) in India and Sweden" on 19th february 2026
content:
Invitation to IP Manthan on “Patentability of Computer-Related Inventions (CRI) in India and Sweden" on 19th february 2026
We are pleased to inform that an IP Manthan session is being organised by the Office of the Controller General of Patents, Designs and Trade Marks (O/o CGPDTM), in collaboration with the Swedish Intellectual Property Office (PRV), to deliberate on:
Patentability of Computer-Related Inventions (CRI) in India and Sweden.
This session would aim to facilitate knowledge-sharing and strengthen cooperation between the O/o CGPDTM and PRV, while providing valuable insights for IP professionals, practitioners, industry representatives, start-ups, academicians and students in the field of intellectual property.
Date: 19 February 2026
Time: 2:30 PM to 4:00 PM (IST)
Mode: Virtual (Webex Platform)
Interested participants are requested to register on or before 18 February 2026, 12:00 AM (IST) through the registration
link: https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSeZUqSAnG1M0zSq8X0bPWL-j8cGCpznwNYTYEuhxYFKzY0k0g/viewform?usp=publish-editor
The meeting link would be shared with registered participants at their registered email addresses.
All stakeholders are encouraged to participate actively in this interactive knowledge-sharing session.
We look forward to your participation.
18-Feb-2026
